arguments.prompt:
Restyle the SAME adult female boxer in the reference into a coherent BASIC-TIER boxing RPG starter outfit. STATIC full-body character illustration only. Straight frontal view, neutral confident stance, arms relaxed slightly away from sides with gloves below waist. Preserve the reference face, warm medium skin, black high ponytail, adult athletic anatomy, moderate muscle volume, and exact believable body proportions. Keep the crisp manhwa/game-illustration outlines and clean painted cel shading. Show all hair and both soles with comfortable margin. One character and one small backpack product inset on a plain light warm gray studio background, no text, no UI, no frame.
Her complete BASIC outfit has six visible equipment pieces:
1 HEAD: simple matte dark petrol-blue cloth headband across the forehead under the same ponytail and loose front locks. Narrow, practical sports fabric, face remains unobstructed.
2 TORSO: an open cropped sleeveless training jacket in charcoal/navy matte jersey, ordinary fabric collar, uncomplicated cream-white side panels with a single narrow desaturated blue stitched edge. Plain charcoal sports bra underneath. Soft cloth construction, ordinary zipper, no armor. Bare arms and abdomen show the original physique. Sporty fitted tailoring gives style without ornament overload.
3 HANDS: a matched pair of conventional rounded closed boxing gloves in matte charcoal leather, proper boxing-glove padded knuckles and attached thumbs, cream-white wrist straps with a small petrol-blue cloth tab. Gloves must look like normal boxing equipment, never fingerless gloves, armored fists or giant gauntlets. Short white hand wraps peek above the glove cuffs. Size them proportionately to her head and forearms.
4 LEGS: loose above-mid-thigh navy boxing trunks, wide plain ribbed waistband, clean cream-white vertical side stripes, a restrained geometric cut at the hem. No metal belt, badges, pouches or skirt. Shorts stay sportswear and preserve her body silhouette.
5 FEET: slim mid-calf navy canvas boxing boots with cream-white laces and a simple cream side stripe, thin flexible soles. Lightweight athletic footwear, never heavy combat boots or greaves.
6 BACK SLOT: a compact practical boxing-gym BACKPACK worn on her back. Soft matte navy canvas, rounded rectangular shape, cream zipper piping and a small dull petrol-blue lower front pocket. Two simple flat shoulder straps visibly cross the jacket from the shoulders down the sides of her chest, then disappear behind the ribs. The bag sits behind her upper torso, its upper edge and a little of the outer silhouette peeking behind the shoulders. Keep it modestly sized and naturally fitted. It is a real backpack, not a towel, scarf, cape, armor or wings. No chest harness, tactical webbing, weapon attachment or heavy buckles. Because the body remains frontal, also include ONE small isolated product illustration of this same backpack in the empty lower-right margin, separate from her body, facing the viewer so its front pocket and zipper can be reviewed. This is a concept-sheet inset only, not a second bag hanging beside her. Keep the main character large and unobstructed with safe spacing from the small inset.
This is the BASIC starter tier: appealing style through silhouette, tidy tailoring, block colors and useful boxing equipment. Restrained charcoal, midnight navy, cream and dull petrol-blue palette. ALL surfaces are non-emissive ordinary cloth, cotton, canvas or leather. No glow, luminous stitching, light trails, aura, particles, flames, animated fabric, metallic armor, jewelry, studs, embossed silver crests, ornate fantasy ornaments, championship belts, weapons or dangling belts. Use soft neutral illustration lighting without dramatic VFX. Do not turn the body. Do not change identity or enlarge her muscles. This is a single static outfit concept illustration with a small backpack product inset, not animation or a sprite sheet.
